passives.name: Oath of Meteos
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases damage proportional to the number of debuffs inflicted on the caster, but reduces damage dealt to targets with a Barrier. Increases damage dealt against non-Water enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Water enemies and increases damage taken from them.
